basis: AI-Gomoku rev 39 answered four of the ten ASYNC axes N/A for its browser Worker (polling, reconciliation: no external system; idempotency, duplicate_execution: a pure display-only computation). A profile cell may say that once; the row may then leave those axes out.

LOCAL.meaning: The work runs on the user's device with no external system: nothing to poll and no remote outcome to reconcile.

LOCAL_PURE.meaning: Local, and the result is only displayed: running it again changes nothing, so there is no idempotency or duplicate execution to guard.
